objective: Prepare a safe, independently measurable small-scale tidal-stream generator laboratory experiment without selecting a winner or conflating mechanical means with blade stress and net electricity.

separation_of_workstreams.laboratory_test: May progress after venue, design, metrology and safety approval; does not require previous FORCE site ADCP qualification to test controlled water.
separation_of_workstreams.site_specific_energy_forecast: Blocked on instrument-qualified site current profiles and independent device performance/electricity validation.
separation_of_workstreams.in_water_test: Separately blocked on site permissions, qualified flow, marine safety, environmental and retrieval provisions.

pilot_comparator.mechanism: Same cross-flow rotor at separately calibrated approximate TSR 2.9 candidate versus 3.1 baseline; historical processed mean drag/Cp reductions alone do not prove load-cycle reduction.
pilot_comparator.acceptance_boundary: Report paired net electrical energy, time-resolved stress cycles, calibration, repeatability/uncertainty and all failures separately; no inferred fatigue life or winner.
